Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell, Government of Maharashtra
MHT-CET (PCB) 2027 — Notification No. 12/2026

Online application form submission on the official portal starts on
12 January 2027. The window closes up to 5:00 pm on 12/03/2027.
The examination will be conducted on 22 April 2027 and 23 April 2027 at
examination centres across Maharashtra. Candidates must appear in person
at the allotted centre; no remote attempt is provided.
Application fee: INR 800 for the open category.
